## Workload

Grader Tomas Brennan completed 721 reads during 392 hours of recorded work. This represents an average throughput of 1.8 reads per hour. The workload was reviewed against the available activity record, with the total number of reads and the recorded hours considered together. The result provides a clear summary of the volume handled during the review period and the corresponding hourly rate.

## Quality

A further 68 reads were checked as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement was 41.2. This result should be considered alongside the sample size and the wider workload information when interpreting the review outcome. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support consistency in subsequent grading.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
